A brief notice about gate calls
It is for guests

Gate Call Notice

Travelers should stay close to the departure area when traveling with pets, since gate calls can move quickly and our team needs a calm handoff. Please keep carriers closed, tags visible, and paperwork ready so the check-in flow stays smooth for everyone.

A senior coordinator oversees daily service decisions, and safety always comes before speed on every journey. <<FACT F012>> If you are traveling with a companion animal, please let the desk know early so we can guide you through the right steps and avoid last-minute stress.

Aurelia Skyways aims for dependable companion travel, and we are glad to help keep pets comfortable and secure along the way. For support, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you head to the gate.
